items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: And so, Mr. Healy did nothing. He played ghetto.

ctx.x: Did he have any other job or did he just play violin? He said he played violin? He played violin, yeah, Johnny Gould

Did he have any other job or did he make his living in music? Well, I don't know. I don't know about any job. I know Ford used to play bass. I don't know what he used to do. I think he used to work at the slaughterhouse. Yeah, the slaughterhouse down at the barracks down there. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And so, Mr. Healy did nothing. He played ghetto. Yeah. Buddy Johnson was really a barber then. He had his own barber shop. Yeah. And Joe Big D. You remember Joe Big D? Yeah, I knew Joe Big D. Well, he used to play trombone…
That was Jimmy Palau, you, you mentioned. Yeah, Jimmy Palau. That helped you with that.
